storyCards.headline: I Want You Back: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Jackson 5's "I Want You Back" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Best Of The Jackson 5: 20th Century Masters: The Christmas Collection" (2017) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Best Of The Jackson 5: 20th Century Masters: The Christmas Collection (2017).
